About
Incorporated in July 1992, Ajax Engineering Limited manufactures a wide range of concrete equipment and services across the value chain.

Key Points
Leading Concrete Equipment Manufacturer
[1]
Ajax Engineering is India’s leading concrete equipment manufacturer. It operates across the entire concrete application value chain
production, transportation, placement, paving and advanced solutions
like 3D concrete printing. It is the second-largest concrete equipment manufacturer in India by volume and has sold 32.9k+ units over the last 10 years.
